# DynamicalCriticality

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
The study of critical phenomena arising in the temporal evolution of a system, here applied to the convergence dynamics of a Monte Carlo algorithm. Understanding critical dynamics can inform how TCC/iNEST systems self-organize near phase transitions, relevant for adaptive computing and neuromorphic stability.
